title: Absorption merge evidence
description: apply.json. The agent's declaration of what it changed, checked against the actual target diff. The declaration exists so a mismatch is detectable at all: without it there is nothing to compare the diff to.

plan_sha256.description: The bound plan this merge claims to carry out. A value that does not match the run's binding means the plan moved under the merge.

changed_files.description: Cumulative, not per attempt: a retry that forgot an earlier file would otherwise look like a clean declaration.
